{{Quote|I confirmed the Sith indeed struck the Republic world of Draethos, though the time frame remains murky. They raided Quermia, and Felucia, and other worlds such as Gand and Florn known to scouts and smugglers.|Sorzus Syn, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
At some point after an [[Invasion of Korriban|invasion]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="BoS" /> and a [[Korriban civil war|civil war]]<ref name="GH07" /> on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around [[27,700 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]] led by the successors to [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]] undertook an '''expansion''' of its territories using captured Rakatan technology. The [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors were unleashed to conquer neighboring worlds, destroying the homes of disobedient people. The Sith were believed to have reached the natural edge of [[Sith Worlds/Legends|their space]]<ref name="BoS" />&mdash;including worlds such as [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]],<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> [[Krayiss II]], [[Khar Delba]], [[Rhelg/Legends|Rhelg]]&mdash;conquering worlds beyond the [[Stygian Caldera]], such as<ref name="BoS" /> [[Malachor V]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BoS" /> [[Tund/Legends|Tund]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BoS" /><ref name="TWW" /> [[Thule/Legends|Thule]],<ref name="BoS" /> and [[Arorua]].<ref name="BoS" /> They [[Attack on Draethos|attacked]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draethos (planet)|Draethos]], and engaged in raids at [[Raid on Quermia|Quermia]], [[Raid on Felucia|Felucia]], [[Raid on Gand|Gand]], and [[Raid on Florn|Florn]].<ref name="BoS" />
